verdict.rationale: Highnote is a SaaS card-issuing and payments platform, so letting a customer choose a data storage region is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence covers PCI, iframe SDKs and roles/permissions, but none of it mentions selecting a data region or residency, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
